datasetRequirements.source: consented, de-identified Chat Memory scenarios; exclude Work Mode Agent Memory

relevanceScale.1: related context but does not answer the requested fact
relevanceScale.2: directly answers or supplies the current requested fact

datasetRequirements.pairedInputs: V1 and V2 must receive the same candidate set, query, clock, ACL and budget

acceptanceGates.overallNdcgAt5: paired bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound for V2 minus V1 must be >= -0.02
acceptanceGates.categoryNdcgAt5: paired bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound must be >= -0.05 in every category
acceptanceGates.precisionAt3: paired bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound for V2 minus V1 must be >= -0.03
acceptanceGates.correctionPriority: latest explicitly corrected evidence must rank above its superseded fact in the top 3 for at least 95% of explicit correction queries
acceptanceGates.staleDetail: zero ACL violations; V2 must not expose exact detail whose R4-H factualDetail is suppressed or latent
acceptanceGates.diversity: distinct relevant fact clusters in top 5 must not regress by more than 0.05 against V1
acceptanceGates.blindContextRating: paired human context-quality rating on a 1-5 scale; V2 mean difference lower 95% confidence bound must be >= -0.2
acceptanceGates.selectorLatency: V2-only p95 must be <= 1.25x V1 p95 on the same host and candidate set

rollbackConditions: any exact-detail exposure beyond the R4-H projection
any failed category or overall non-inferiority gate
selector latency above the registered limit
notes: Do not lower these thresholds after seeing V2 results.
The current Phase A/B/C.1 synthetic fixtures validate mechanics only and are not a substitute for this labeled set.
